caption: The video captures a steady, close-angle view of a Space Shuttle aft section during an ongoing static engine test. The white vehicle body fills the upper portion, with two large bell-shaped main-engine nozzles flanking a smaller dark central nozzle that remains unlit. Below the bells, an intense orange-yellow exhaust glow and bright horizontal arcs of illuminated spray churn continuously, while white steam billows across the lower half. A metal platform railing runs across the foreground, and a facility wall with ladders and mounted equipment boxes stands at the right, remaining in view with no visible translation or lift-off. As time advances, the left main-engine bell brightens from a dim orange throat toward a near-white illuminated disc, with the right bell also becoming brighter. The spray arcs and overall exhaust luminance surge and settle over time, indicating a pulsating firing already underway. The bright steam and spray continue to move beneath the glowing nozzles.
